modifier.description: [S4] Casting Resonance Skill: Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, or Frostblight: Petalfall increases the damage dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.
When applying Glacio Chafe, Glacio DMG is Amplified by 56% for 20 seconds.
When applying Glacio Chafe, Liberation DMG ignore 20% DEF for 20 seconds.
Inflicting Glacio Chafe on enemies increases Glacio DMG dealt by 10% for 15s.

modifier.description: For 25 seconds: increases the Offtune Buildup Rate of all Resonators by 50%. Every 3 seconds, heals the active resonator.

procModifiers.description: When the wielder heals Resonators, increases Crit. DMG of all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 4s.
When healing a Resonator in the team, every 1% of Off-Tune Buildup Rate grants a 0.2% ATK increase to all Resonators in the team for 4s, up to 25%.
